nodes.label: @cryengine/ckeditor5-classic custom build
nodes.rationale: Forked from the upstream classic build so the editor chrome carries the CRYENGINE color schema matching the shared StyleGuide project.

nodes.label: SSH agent bootstrap in before_script
nodes.rationale: SSH_PRIVATE_KEY is piped through `tr -d '\r'` to strip CR line endings so ed25519 keys load without extra base64 encoding; DOCKER_DRIVER=overlay2 is set for build performance and DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR for puppet-provided runner keys.

nodes.label: Tag-triggered release gate
nodes.rationale: Publishing runs `only: tags` and derives the package version from $CI_COMMIT_TAG with --no-git-tag-version, so the git tag is the single source of truth for the released version and no commit is created by CI.

nodes.label: Advanced setup: import source modules
nodes.rationale: For deep integration the docs recommend importing the source modules directly instead of the prebuilt bundle, because the prebuilt bundle fixes the plugin set and configuration at build time.
